milestones.description: Uses inventory_has to check for 'flower_pot' (min_count=1) because mining a potted_poppy block drops both a flower_pot and a poppy item into the player's inventory. This rule type is preferred for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory. The player starts with no flower_pot in inventory (no /give commands in scene setup), so having one confirms the potted_poppy was successfully mined.
